data.one_liner: CLI tool for managing, testing, and releasing packages across Flutter team repositories
data.what_it_does: Provides command-line utilities for formatting, static analysis, running native/Dart tests, and managing releases across multi-package Flutter repositories. It is specifically built for Flutter ecosystem repos like flutter/packages and flutter/core-packages. The tool automates checks such as CHANGELOG validation, dependency updating, and safe package publishing.
use_when: Contributing to official Flutter team repositories like flutter/packages or flutter/core-packages
Running multi-package repository checks, static analysis, or native tests matching Flutter team standards
avoid_when: Developing regular standalone Flutter applications or general non-Flutter-team repositories
Managing general-purpose Dart monorepos outside Flutter team tooling
strengths: Tailored specifically for Flutter monorepos with multi-platform native and Dart testing
Comprehensive automation for repo standards, CHANGELOG management, and safe pub publishing
Supports granular package targeting, federated plugins, and staged package filtering
weaknesses: Explicitly targeted at flutter/* repositories and no longer intended for third-party or general use
Strictly tied to Flutter team conventions, configs, and tooling requirements
data.setup_notes: Activated via 'dart pub global activate flutter_plugin_tools' or run locally from within the flutter/packages repository. Requires Flutter-bundled Dart first in PATH.

alternatives.name: melos
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick melos for managing general Dart and Flutter monorepos outside of the official Flutter team repositories.
